title: Nutty Chinese Bresaola Ma La Tang
description: A malty, crunchy Chinese dish featuring bresaola, perfect for a date night, originating from the Zhejiang region, this kosher-friendly recipe is served in the form of a ma-la-tang.
instructions: In a large pot, combine 2 cups of water, maltose syrup, soy sauce, sesame oil, star anise, ginger, and garlic, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the bresaola slices to the pot and steam for 5 minutes.
While the bresaola is steaming, toast the crushed peanuts in a dry pan over medium heat until fragrant.
Add the toasted peanuts, scallions, and dates to the pot and stir to combine.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Nutty Chinese Bresaola Ma La Tang hot, garnished with additional scallions and peanuts if desired.
Steam the bresaola for an additional 2 minutes if a more tender texture is preferred.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
